content.title: Documents and Downloads
content.summary: The City of Arvada Development Team provides guides and checklists to assist applicants in preparing complete applications for development projects, emphasizing the importance of understanding the Land Development Code (LDC) and Engineering Code. Applicants can access various resources, including development application checklists and civil construction documents, and are encouraged to contact city planners or the Community and Economic Development Department for any inquiries.
content.body:
The City of Arvada Development Team has assembled these guides and checklists as a courtesy to assist applicants with compiling a complete application to expedite the review process. However, it is the responsibility of every applicant to be familiar with the requirements of the LDC and Engineering Code and to clearly show how the application meets those requirements.

- The most recent [Land Development Code (LDC) can be found at this link.](/179/Land-Development-Code)
- View the most recent City [Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications](/167/Engineering-Code-of-Standards-Specificat) for the Design and Construction of Public Improvements.

If you have any questions about these guides, please contact the City Planner or City Development Engineer you have been working with, or the Community and Economic Development Department at 720-898-7435 or [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection)
